name: player_update_camera_variant_from_camera_pos
description: Player::UpdateCameraVariantFromCameraPos temporarily disables player root cell picking, samples camera-floor pick candidates below a camera position, updates the camera variant from the selected anchor when sampling succeeds, and marks the camera variant updated for the tick.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x406470 validates fastcall ECX=saveState, EDX=cameraPos, temporary gwNodeSetCellPickable(rootNode, 0/1), BuildPickCandidateListBelowPoint(g_Player_RuntimeDiScene, candidateBuffers, cameraPos->x, 500.0f, cameraPos->z), success-only SelectProbeSampleHeightFromCandidates(cameraPos->y, 0.00100000005f, pickResult, ...), success-only UpdateCameraVariantFromAnchor, and unconditional g_Player_CameraVariantUpdatedThisTick = 1.

The native smoke verifies the no-candidate path restores root cell picking, preserves cameraPos, and still marks the variant updated for the tick; the success path is delegated to already accepted SelectProbeSampleHeightFromCandidates and UpdateCameraVariantFromAnchor behavior.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x406470 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
